info.title: API.SH: Bayut
info.description: The Bayut API from API.SH: public Bayut data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Real estate agencies on Bayut, by name and/or the areas they serve: id, name, logo, link, office location, areas served, phone, mobile and WhatsApp, licence numbers and authorities, number of agents and verified agents, listings for sale and for rent, property types, languages. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bayut-agencies

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Only agencies with live listings in this location, as the site's agencies directory for that area lists them: a slug path like `dubai/dubai-marina`, a location id from `/bayut/v1/locations`, or a place name (best match; the response's `location_match` says which).

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: `true`: only agencies with at least one live listing, as Bayut's directory lists them. Default `false` returns every agency on Bayut. With `location` this is always on.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Bayut listing by id or link: title, price, rent frequency, bedrooms, bathrooms, area, furnishing, completion status and date, off-plan details and payment plans where given, location path with coordinates, description, features, every photo, video and tour counts, floor plan flag, reference and permit numbers, verification, agency and agent with contact numbers, posting and update dates, and the original record in `raw`. Rented, sold or removed listings answer 404.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bayut-listing

get.description:
UAE cities, areas, communities and buildings matching a name: the id and slug path the search takes as `location`, level, full path, number of listings, coordinates and completion status.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bayut-locations

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: City, area, community or building name.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
UAE properties for rent or sale on Bayut with the site's filters and sorts: category (residential and commercial types), locations (slug paths or ids from /bayut/v1/locations), bedrooms, bathrooms, price, area, furnishing, ready or off-plan, rent frequency, keywords, verified, video, 360 tour, one agency's or one agent's listings. Each listing has its id, title, link, price, rent frequency, bedrooms, bathrooms, area in sqft and sqm, furnishing, completion status, location path with coordinates, description, features, photos, video and tour counts, reference and verification, the agency and agent with their contact numbers, posting and update dates, and the original record in `raw`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/bayut-search

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Instead of the filters: a bayut.com search link (/to-rent/... or /for-sale/...); its category, location, bedrooms and query filters are used.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Property type, comma-separated: residential, apartments, villas, townhouses, penthouses, hotel-apartments, villa-compound, residential-plots, residential-floors, residential-building, commercial, offices, shops, warehouses, labour-camps, commercial-villas, bulk-units, commercial-plots, commercial-floors, commercial-buildings, factories, industrial-land, mixed-use-land, showrooms, other-commercial.

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Location slug paths as in the site's links (`dubai`, `dubai/dubai-marina`, `abu-dhabi/al-reem-island`) or ids from /bayut/v1/locations, comma-separated.

parameters.name: verified
parameters.description: Only verified listings (true) or only unverified ones (false).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
